ConnectionStrings._comment_KI-027: Same non-superuser app role as backend/ShelfGuard.Api/appsettings.Development.json. The tool asserts 'SET LOCAL app.role = provider' itself for the cross-tenant read+write — NEVER point this at the 'crm' bootstrap superuser (bypasses RLS unconditionally). Override with the env var ConnectionStrings__DefaultConnection when running against staging / production.
